claim: Either some a_i>=19/20, or a positive short a>=1/(20*M) exists with ceil((7/5)/a)<=28*M and copied length in [7/5,19/10). The required first-endpoint multiplicity vectors can therefore be selected from a finite family for fixed M.
decisive_argument: If there is a long length, its complementary short total is at least 1/20; otherwise the entire unit mass is short. Pigeonhole and an integer upper bound for the ceiling give the claimed copy bound.
